stratagems.name: Honour the Chapter
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of that attack.

stratagems.name: Adaptive Strategy
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit gains the Scouts 6" ability and the Infiltrators ability.

stratagems.name: Rapid Deployment
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally from all enemy models.

stratagems.name: Fortress of Will
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target and that is on or within an objective marker.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Strength characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.name: Storm of Fire
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 automatically wounds the target.
